audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[].side disagreed with content win[] in three rows (2, 3, 4, 5 used 'Skill' placeholder) and phases[0-1].why described KARMA winning even though side already correctly said Brand.
audit.why: packet.levelChart = [Brand,Brand,Brand,Karma,Brand,Brand,Karma] matches content win[0..6] exactly; the full layer's side and why fields were stale/templated.
audit.corrected: Set phases[2,4,5].side to Brand and phases[3,6].side to Karma to match win[], and rewrote why for every row (0-6) so the text actually names who wins and why, grounded in content whys[].

audit.whatIsWrong: n/a — spikes[1] (Lvl 6 Pyroclasm+Blaze) and spikes[2] (1st item Liandry's/Luden's chunk) already name the real spikes.
audit.why: Confirmed against kit: R Pyroclasm 100/90/80s CD, W Pillar of Flame adds 25% damage to ablazed targets.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no real cooldown number (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: Sear only stuns an already-ablazed target, and its cooldown (8-6s) is short enough to matter for trade timing.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns with Sear (Q) 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s, Pillar of Flame (W) 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s, and R Pyroclasm 100/90/80s.

edits.before: RQ from level 1 — the empowered poke is the strongest level-1 button in the role.
edits.after: His Sear (Q) and Pillar of Flame (W) out-damage your Inner Flame at level 1 — he has no reason to respect your poke range.

edits.before: Q-chip the contacts; the mantra cycle taxes every trade they consider.
edits.after: His stun-primed W-Q combo chunks harder than your Mantra-Q at level 2 — he doesn't need to land Sear first to win the exchange.

edits.before: Full kit: tether the overstep, shield-speed the trades — the lane bully era peaks here.
edits.after: Blaze detonations still out-trade your poke at level 3 — his raw magic damage leads the exchange even with your full kit online.

edits.before: Chip below all-in range and call the jungler — your RQ-W chains convert every gank.
edits.after: Your kit stabilises and you can dodge Sear to answer back — this is your window, before his level-6 spike closes it.

edits.before: No new ult — press the early lead; scaling supports are waking up behind you.
edits.after: R Pyroclasm (100/90/80s) plus Blaze burst reasserts a lethal poke lead through a Sear stun.

edits.before: First item: RQ chunks and RE engages — convert to plates and picks now.
edits.after: With Liandry's or Luden's his every-spell chunk zones you and your ADC under tower — his sustained poke out-ranges your Q.

edits.before: Late Karma enables: RE the engage, tether the diver, RQ the sieges.
edits.after: Late he's a squishy immobile mage — your Focused Resolve root and Mantra-E disengage punish his positioning and flip the 2v2.

edits.before: RQ the carry at wave contact, tether the answer, walk — the chip leads the lane's ledger.
edits.after: Sidestep Sear the moment it leaves his hand — a landed stun chains straight into W-Q-E burst that can delete you.

edits.before: Spending mantra on a wave while the enemy banks theirs for your face.
edits.after: Standing in the Pillar of Flame zone for one extra trade lets Blaze stack to detonation — that's a third free hit.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns the ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your RE shield-speed answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Sear (Q) is 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s and only stuns an ablazed target — after eating W or E, the stun line is dodgeable. - Pillar of Flame (W) is 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s and adds 25% damage to anything ablaze — don't stand in the zone. - R Pyroclasm is 100/90/80s; his real threat is stacking Blaze with W-E, not the ult alone.

notes: packet itself flags this contradiction (defects: 'level chart contradicts data: Karma wins 55.08% but chart gives Brand 5/7 stages') — the fix here makes the full layer agree with the content layer's chart, which is the resolvable half of that defect; the deeper WR-vs-chart tension is inherent to the data and left as-is per the rule to not guess.
